Special-use self-storage => permitted under owner policy. No warehouse/industrial use listed for B-1.

A-1.quote: § 8.2.B A-1 Permitted Uses: "... 20. Warehouse/Distribution. 21. Wholesale Goods Establishment." § 8.2.C Special Uses: "4. Industrial Assembly Use. 5. Industrial Use, Light." Ch. 8 Summary: "Warehouse/Distribution P P P P" (A-1 M-A M-1 O-R). Ch. 2: "WAREHOUSE/DISTRIBUTION. A structure, or part thereof, or area used principally for the storage of goods and merchandise." Warehouse by right => ss/mw permitted (owner policy); Mini-Warehouse neither named nor excluded in Ch. 8. #38: A-1 = Artisan District (manufacturing family), not agricultural.

M-A.quote: § 8.3.B M-A Permitted Uses: "... 12. Industrial Assembly Use. 13. Industrial Use, Light. ... 23. Warehouse/Distribution. 24. Wholesale Goods Establishment." Ch. 8 Summary: "Industrial Use, Light S P P" / "Warehouse/Distribution P P P P". Warehouse/LI by right => ss/mw permitted (owner policy); Mini-Warehouse neither named nor excluded in Ch. 8.

M-1.quote: § 8.4.A: "The purpose of the M-1 Limited Manufacturing District is to provide an environment for light industrial uses ..."; § 8.4.B M-1 Permitted Uses: "... 9. Industrial Assembly Use. 10. Industrial Use, Light. ... 16. Warehouse/Distribution. 17. Wholesale Goods Establishment." Warehouse/LI by right => ss/mw permitted (owner policy); Mini-Warehouse neither named nor excluded in Ch. 8.

O-R.quote: § 8.5.A: "The district also provides for a limited amount of light assembly, processing and distribution uses along with their related support activities." § 8.5.B O-R Permitted Uses: "... 5. Warehouse by right => ss/mw permitted (owner policy).

B-R.quote: § 9.2.B B-R Permitted Uses: "1. Art Studio. 2. Bed and Breakfast Establishment. 3. Day Care Home. 4. Dwellings, Single-Family. 5. Home Occupations. 6. Office, Government. 7.
